title: Rosalind and the Weather
author: Paloma Almeida
blurb: Kestrel Okafor, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
